entities.name: Bacterial uS8 query
observations: 131-aa protein; calculated molecular weight 14,098 Da and theoretical pI 9.55 (sequence-derived).
Exact full-length sequence match to reviewed Cupriavidus uS8 reference(s); annotated as a 30S ribosomal protein binding the 16S rRNA central domain and supporting small-subunit assembly.
Pfam Ribosomal_S8 (PF00410.25) detected at residues 5–130; annotated roles include rRNA binding, ribosome structural constituent, and translation.
